actions.item: Cross-lane replay prevention in central five-cycle coordinator
actions.before: Previously a new commit SHA could cause identical file bytes to be counted a second time
actions.change: Deduplicate accepted sources globally by immutable path plus sha256 across all A-E runs
actions.after: Canonical artifact identity guards record and verified summary, tested against restored identical bytes

actions.item: Worker cumulative successful-action counter anti-replay alignment
actions.before: Cumulative proof identity included commit and could accept same file content through a later commit
actions.change: Reuse central artifact_identity(path,sha256) in durable worker reconciliation
actions.after: Worker cumulative counting excludes proof replays with changed commit IDs, with ledger regression suite passing

actions.item: Auditor refuses stale previous-hour results as current hourly success
actions.before: Auditor's most recent successful manifest counted indefinitely as latest 50/50 despite elapsed hours
actions.change: Apply 75-minute freshness gate to latest_run_success, preserve historical verified counters separately
actions.after: After hourly freshness expires, current success resets to zero while historical validated work remains visible; CI regression passed
